integrity: The proof supplies exact gap data, a bijection of exceptional classes with restricted partitions, and a pole-based asymptotic; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to indexed linear binary words with exactly three ones and the set (not multiset) of compositions of nonempty contiguous factors. Historical priority is qualified because unindexed equivalent work may exist; the general prefix-normal-form theorem and the classical restricted-partition sequence are credited as prior. Finite checks do not prove unrestricted claims.
title: Exact jumbled-spectrum ambiguity for binary words with three ones
